title: FinTech Startup for Sale in Doha, Qatar
tagline: Pre revenue company which is a QFC-licensed FinTech company based in Doha, Qatar, established in March of this year. The operations are set to launch soon. - Company is set to offer a full range of services, including real-time transaction processing, digital wallets, and payment gateways. - The expertise includes algorithm-based portfolio management, token and digital asset services, and blockchain solutions. - It is an application that will be used for online payments, cryptocurrency, AI-driven bot, banking, stocks, and bonds. - As part of the sale, investor will get commercial bank accounts in both Qatari Riyals and to trade in US Dollars, along with a trademarked unique app concept. - Business has a working prototype ready and a demo video showcasing the first iteration of our idea. - The founder has a strong background in fintech and AI, skilled in strategy, compliance, and innovative monetization systems. - This is a prime opportunity to tap into the growing fintech market with a ready-to-launch platform.
